statement.zh: 一号坑器物多有焚烧痕迹而坑壁未见火烧，发掘者/Bagley 综述指火焚发生在入坑之前。
statement.en: Pit 1 objects show burning while pit walls do not; excavators/Bagley summarize burning before deposition.
